company.name: DEKODE
company.about: DEKODE helps businesses and communities modernise their systems, adopt AI with confidence, and build digital products that teams actually want to use. We handle the complexity so you don’t have to: from strategy and architecture through to build, security, and long-term support.
company.mission: We make technology work for the people who use it.
company.vision: DEKODE is building toward becoming a trusted global technology partner for businesses navigating that shift. Our goal is simple: make digital transformation and AI adoption accessible, affordable, and genuinely useful for the people it’s meant to serve.
company.belief: Progress only counts when it reaches everyone.

services.name: AI Strategy & Consulting
services.summary: Most businesses know AI matters. Fewer know where to start. We help you cut through the noise, identify the use cases that will actually move the needle, and build a roadmap grounded in your real data, workflows, and goals. Not hype.
capabilities: AI readiness assessment and opportunity mapping
Use case selection, ROI logic, and prioritisation
Data and workflow review to determine what's needed to make AI work
Responsible AI guidance covering privacy, safety, and governance
Vendor-neutral tool and platform recommendations
services.audience: Businesses exploring AI for the first time, or those who’ve tried and need a clearer direction.

services.name: Custom AI Development
services.summary: Build AI that fits your business. Not the other way around. Off-the-shelf AI rarely solves the specific problems your team faces every day. We design and develop custom AI solutions, from machine learning models to generative AI features, that plug directly into your operations and deliver measurable results.
capabilities: Custom AI and machine learning development
Generative AI solutions tailored to your workflows
Internal copilots, intelligent search, and knowledge systems
AI-powered support, sales enablement, and operations tools
From proof-of-concept to production-grade deployment
services.audience: Businesses with a specific problem or idea that needs purpose-built AI to solve it.

services.name: Web & Mobile Development
services.summary: Build apps and interfaces that people actually want to use. A powerful system means nothing if your team can’t navigate it. We design and develop web apps, mobile apps, dashboards, and internal tools with user experience at the centre, so adoption happens naturally, not by force.
capabilities: Web application development
iOS and Android mobile apps
UX/UI design: user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, and design systems
Dashboards and internal portals for operations, visibility, and decision-making
Rapid prototyping through to production-ready delivery
services.audience: Businesses building a new digital product, or modernising existing tools that teams have outgrown.

services.name: AI-Powered E-Commerce Development
services.summary: Smarter shopping experiences that convert and scale. E-commerce is no longer just a storefront. It’s a system of recommendations, personalisation, search intelligence, and automation. We build e-commerce platforms with AI woven in from the ground up, so your customers get better experiences and your operations run leaner.
capabilities: AI-powered e-commerce platform development
Personalised product recommendations and intelligent search
Automated inventory, pricing, and fulfilment workflows
Performance and UX optimisation
Scalable architecture built for growth
services.audience: Retailers and brands launching or upgrading their online presence with AI-driven competitive advantage.

services.name: Integrations & Automation
services.summary: Connect your tools. Automate the repetitive work. Free your team to focus. Most businesses run on a patchwork of systems that don’t talk to each other. We connect your stack, build custom integrations, and automate the manual processes that slow your team down, so information flows cleanly and work gets done faster.
capabilities: Payment gateway integrations
Chat, text, and email integrations
Custom API development and third-party connections
DevOps pipelines and CI/CD setup
Business process automation across operations, finance, and support
services.audience: Businesses drowning in manual workflows, disconnected platforms, or fragile integrations that keep breaking.

services.name: Cloud, Managed IT & Security
services.summary: Secure, scalable foundations, with someone watching the systems so you don’t have to. Everything we build runs on infrastructure that’s designed for reliability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability. We handle cloud strategy, migration, day-to-day IT management, and security hardening as one connected service. Not separate line items from separate teams.
capabilities: Cloud consulting and migration across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
Infrastructure architecture, monitoring, and incident readiness
Identity and access management, data protection, and encryption
Security posture reviews, threat modelling, and risk reduction
Ongoing managed IT support, patching, and performance optimisation
services.audience: Businesses that need their systems to be stable, secure, and professionally managed, without building a full in-house IT team.

faqs.question: What does DEKODE do?
faqs.answer: DEKODE combines AI consultancy, solution development, infrastructure, security, and long-term support to deliver practical systems teams can adopt.

faqs.question: Who does DEKODE work with?
faqs.answer: DEKODE partners with small and medium businesses across education, healthcare, finance, accounting, legal, food and agriculture, retail.

faqs.question: How does DEKODE deliver projects?
faqs.answer: DEKODE follows five stages: Discover, Design, Build, Secure, Run & Optimise.
